jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Copperleaf AI

Copperleaf AI builds assistants that help insurance adjusters read claims faster. Our product turns long documents into short, checked answers, and it is used by claims teams at a dozen carriers.

The role

You will build the applied AI features behind that product. That means working with large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases and evaluation harnesses, and turning research prototypes into reliable services.

What you will do

  • Build retrieval-augmented generation pipelines in Python on top of LLM APIs
  • Design evaluation suites that measure answer quality, cost and latency
  • Build TypeScript and React tools that let adjusters review model output
  • Run services on AWS and keep them observable
  • Work closely with our ML researchers to ship their ideas

What we are looking for

  • 1 to 3 years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Python; comfortable with TypeScript
  • Experience with LLM applications, embeddings or vector search (PyTorch or fine-tuning is a plus)
  • Curiosity about how models fail

Salary range $150,000 to $190,000 plus equity. San Francisco office, four days a week.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Copperleaf AI

Copperleaf AI builds assistants that help insurance adjusters read claims faster.

The role

As a Data Analyst you will turn product and customer data into clear reports for our leadership team. You will work with SQL, Excel and Tableau every day. This role does not involve writing production software.

What you will do

  • Build weekly dashboards in Tableau on customer usage and revenue
  • Write SQL queries to answer questions from sales and finance
  • Prepare slide decks and summaries for stakeholder meetings

What we are looking for

  • 2+ years of experience as a data or business analyst
  • Strong SQL and Excel; Tableau preferred
  • Clear communication with non-technical teams

Salary range $85,000 to $110,000. San Francisco office.
